brief: Prioritise outstanding work orders for this ageing unit against its ability to shed heat before the forecast heat event begins, completing tasks in categories 1 to 3 where crew capacity allows [SOP-016]. If the unit's ageing condition cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period [MG-021].
